project: Back-of-house kitchen refit (prep line, cabinets, counters, lighting)

milestones.name: Demolition & rough-in
milestones.release_condition: Released on signing as the materials deposit.

clause.quote: Milestone 1 – Demolition & rough-in: USD 4,000.00, released on signing as the materials deposit.

milestones.name: Cabinets & countertops installed
milestones.release_condition: Client receives photos of installed base cabinets and countertops.

clause.quote: Milestone 2 – Cabinets & countertops installed: USD 5,000.00, released when the Client receives photos of installed base cabinets and countertops.

milestones.name: Lighting, finish & sign-off
milestones.release_condition: Client receives the City of Kirkland final electrical inspection report and a walkthrough.

clause.quote: Milestone 3 – Lighting, finish & sign-off: USD 3,000.00, released on the Client's receipt of the City of Kirkland final electrical inspection report and a walkthrough.
Deposit and milestone funds shall be spent only on building materials, lumber, hardware, plumbing and electrical supplies, and paint for this Project.

prohibited_spend.description: Meals, travel, fuel, or tools retained by the Contractor.

clause.quote: Funds shall not be used for meals, travel, fuel, or tools retained by the Contractor.
Substantial completion no later than December 18, 2026. Project funds shall not be drawn after this date without a signed change order.

change_order_clause.quote: Any change to price, scope, or schedule requires a written change order signed by both parties.
